proposedContracts.name: matches native SDX decode framecrc WAV raw and AU for four depths three rates name lengths 0 to 255 and three lengths
proposedContracts.scope: 48 synthesized inputs (depths 8/16/24/32 x 8000/22050/44100 Hz x names 0/1/17/255 bytes) x 4 decode outputs (framecrc, WAV, s32le, AU) byte-exact against native run at test time. Wave 2 branch wave2/fmt-sdx.

proposedContracts.name: matches native SDX decode with output -ss -t and -frames:a through framecrc and WAV
proposedContracts.scope: 4 inputs x 6 output time profiles x framecrc and WAV, 48 byte-exact comparisons. Wave 2 branch wave2/fmt-sdx.

proposedContracts.name: refuses SDX -c copy before any output exists while native copies with a 1/90000 time base
proposedContracts.scope: Native copy asserted to succeed with #tb 1/90000 and the default packet span; EdgeFFmpeg refuses framecrc and raw copy (exit 1) before output. Wave 2 branch wave2/fmt-sdx.

proposedContracts.name: matches native SDX statuses for depth 12 a missing 0x1a and other invalid headers, and refuses unmirrored inputs before output
proposedContracts.scope: 9 native exit statuses (183, host EINVAL mapped to Linux 234) matched with no output; 3 native-accepted inputs refused explicitly. Wave 2 branch wave2/fmt-sdx.

proposedContracts.name: matches native -f sdx on free text that native detection would hand to the mov probe
proposedContracts.scope: Native undeclared status 183 (mov probe) asserted; -f sdx framecrc byte-exact. Wave 2 branch wave2/fmt-sdx.

proposedContracts.name: maps the four depths and nothing else to unsigned little-endian PCM
proposedContracts.scope: Depth table and refusals. No native run. Wave 2 branch wave2/fmt-sdx.

proposedContracts.name: scans for 0x1a in bounded reads and parses the header without reading the payload
proposedContracts.scope: Header parse at read budgets 1..64, names 0/1/255, bounded requests, packets after a seek. No native run. Wave 2 branch wave2/fmt-sdx.

proposedContracts.name: fails like read_header with INVALIDDATA and refuses the unmirrored forms
proposedContracts.scope: Every refusal with its exit status. No native run. Wave 2 branch wave2/fmt-sdx.

proposedContracts.name: checks the abort signal around every read
proposedContracts.scope: AbortSignal before, during and after open. No native run. Wave 2 branch wave2/fmt-sdx.

proposedContracts.name: probes the exact SDX: head and registers a demux-only descriptor
proposedContracts.scope: 4-byte probe, frozen demux-only descriptor, input seek refusal. No native run. Wave 2 branch wave2/fmt-sdx.

proposedContracts.name: decodes through the PCM backend and refuses copy, input seeks, sdx output and bad inputs before any output opens
proposedContracts.scope: Backend routing with no output opened on refusal. No native run. Wave 2 branch wave2/fmt-sdx.

notes: Sandbox Node was 22.23.5 and bootstrap requires Node 24, so Node 24.22.3 was installed from the npm 'node@24' package (~6 s) and used for every run.
Setup durations: bootstrap 281.7 s total (npm 10.5 s, submodule 8.4 s, reference build ~263 s on 4 vCPUs); baseline typecheck+lint+boundaries+registry tests ~86 s.
Baseline before changes: typecheck, lint, boundaries and tests/unit/container-registry*.test.ts (3 files, 17 tests) passed; all still pass after.
No linux-gated cases: integer and byte-copy paths only.
Probe: native mov_probe outscores sdx_probe (50) when bytes 4..7 are an mp4 atom type such as 'free'; this divergence is tested and documented, not mirrored.
